# HAPI v0.27.3.5

## Compared with the previous maintained release

- Rebuilt from upstream `901f17d0c` (16 new official commits since v0.27.3.4's base `febbf8ff5`). Ten previously-carried PRs are now officially merged and superseded: #1471, #1490, #1495, #1530, #1546, #1547, #1562 (SSE mobile recovery, originally fork PR #5), #1565, #1568, #1569, and fork PR #6 / #1570 (Pi slash commands) — the official #1570 includes the post-v0.27.3.4 fixes (compaction summary rendered as a dedicated chat block, cancellation acknowledged during discovery, provider-qualified /model selectors, queued-thinking grace preservation).
- New upstream content this cycle: #1544 (clear action for collapsed session search), #1550 (share actions stay visible during generation), #1576 (lower context warning thresholds), #1577 (on-demand AI title suggestions), #1578 (aligned new-session and settings controls).
- New carries: #1573 (preserve the current Fork action while reading history), #1581 (clear stale composer drafts after delayed queued sends), and fork PR #7 / #1582 (map codex-enveloped compact-summary to the chat block; removes a duplicate fixture key).
- The v0.27.3.4 in-tree carry set is retained via the fork overlay (#1541 #1543 #1548 #1552 #1557 #1560 #1563 #906 #1422 #1414 #847 #987 #945 #1447 #1158 #1424 #1469 #1418 #955).
- Per the 2026-08-13 operator ruling, PR #1091 (managed agent API profiles) stays `drop`; PR #1320 remains permanently excluded.

## Compared with the official release

- Same maintained overlay as `v0.27.3.4` (session-roots guard, #906 steer superset, migration ladder, fork release pipeline) on official HAPI `v0.27.3` plus the 16 new upstream commits through `901f17d0c`, plus the three new carries above.
- Uses four-part version `0.27.3.5`; platform optional dependencies remain pinned to official `0.27.3`.
